Công Ty TNHH Tập Đoàn Hoàng Thị

HotPrint is the paper packaging brand of Tập Đoàn Hoàng Thị. We bring ideas, technical work and production together to help businesses create packaging suited to their products and brand identity.

02THE HOTPRINT STORY

Care in our work.
Trust in each relationship.

Hoàng Thị began its journey on 6 September 2004. Built on paper packaging, the HotPrint brand has grown alongside businesses and the changing ways products are packed, presented and used.

  1. 2004

    Beginning in Vietnam

    Tập Đoàn Hoàng Thị was established, laying the foundation for HotPrint.

  2. 2018

    Extending international connections

    An Australian branch opened, extending connections to international markets.

03HOW WE WORK TOGETHER

Understand the product.
Understand what it should say.

Purchasing teams need a clear conversation. From the initial brief to approval and handover, agree together on what needs to be done and reviewed.

  1. 01

    Understand your needs

    Start with the product, its users and the brand goal. Clarify the brief together to choose the structure, material and expression.

  2. 02

    Agree on the sample

    Review printed content, dimensions and opening details. Discuss approval points before confirming how the project will be made.

  3. 03

    Connect production

    A clear approved reference supports communication between stages. Business-specific requirements are discussed for each project.

    Explore the factory
  4. 04

    Keep the conversation going

    Discuss receipt of the order, any adjustments and the next brief. Each project is another opportunity to understand your product.
